I've saved the 3분기 answers to `/work/answer.json`. Run on 2분기, the same script reproduces all 10 reference values exactly.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 1위 세그먼트 | smb, 311,694,870원 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 241명 |
| c. 순매출 1위 카테고리 | sw, 242,903,532원 |
| d. 순매출이 가장 큰 달 | 2025-07 |
| e. 환불액 합계 1위 고객 | u81@ex.com |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 233명 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 716,423원 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | 2.0% |

The 2분기 values only matched after I made two assumptions about the data:

- **Dates are in Korean time.** The timestamps are stored in UTC (`...Z`), but the quarter and month boundaries only match when shifted +9 hours. Without the shift, 2분기 came out at 201,943,899원 for `a_net` and 16.0% for `h_growth`, both wrong.
- **One customer means one email.** There are 300 customer records but only 250 distinct emails. Counting by email (ignoring spaces and capitalization) gave 233 for b and 195 for f, which match. Counting by customer ID gave 275 and 222.

I also cleaned up segment names before grouping, since the data has variants like `SMB` and ` consumer`. Refunds are summed per order line.

STATUS: DONE
